name: Article 1 – § 1 – point 1; Directive 2003/87/EC – Article 10a – § 2a – sub§ 1
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive 2003/87/EC as regards revised benchmark values for the heat and fuel benchmarks for the period from 2026 to 2030
part_text: Notwithstanding paragraph 2, third subparagraph, points (c) and (d), the Commission shall set the benchmarks for heat and fuels for the period from 2027 to 2030 at the level of the corresponding benchmarks that applied for the period from 2021 to 2025. The Commission shall adopt the implementing acts necessary for the application of this subparagraph in accordance with paragraph 2.
